title: Edit speech with an instruction (AuK)
description: Edits a recording (up to ~15 s, as input plus output must stay under 30 s) as instructed: replace words ("Replace 'old words' with 'new words'."), pitch ("Raise the pitch by 2 semitones."), speed ("Adjust the speech speed to 1.5x."), volume, emotion or style, remove noise, or separate the voice. Returns an MP3.

params.name: instruction
params.description: What to change, in plain language.

params.name: seconds
params.description: Output length; 0 keeps the input's length. Set it for speed or content edits that change the length.

params.name: seed
params.description: Same seed and params give the same result. Random when omitted.

params.name: steps
params.description: Sampling steps; fewer is faster, 32 is the reference.

inputs.voice_description: A neutral, balanced adult voice, clear and even, speaking at a natural pace.
